stories.name_en: 5G broadband customers targeted by end of 2030
stories.story_fr: T-Mobile vise 15 millions d’abonnés haut débit 5G fin 2030, contre 12 millions fin 2028 dans l’objectif précédent.
stories.story_en: T-Mobile targets 15 million 5G broadband customers by end of 2030, up from a previous target of 12 million by end of 2028.
stories.citation: increasing its 5G broadband customer target to 15 million by the end of 2030, a 25% increase from its previous target of 12 million by the end of 2028

stories.name_en: T-Fiber customers targeted by end of 2030
stories.story_fr: T-Mobile prévoit entre 3 et 4 millions de clients fibre T-Fiber fin 2030.
stories.story_en: T-Mobile expects between 3 and 4 million T-Fiber customers by the end of 2030.
stories.citation: it expects to have between 3 and 4 million T-Fiber customers by the end of 2030

stories.name_fr: Clients haut débit totaux visés fin 2030
stories.name_en: Total broadband customers targeted by end of 2030
stories.explanation: Somme du 5G et de la fibre.
stories.story_fr: T-Mobile s’attend désormais à 18 à 19 millions de clients haut débit au total fin 2030.
stories.story_en: T-Mobile now expects 18 to 19 million total broadband customers by the end of 2030.
stories.citation: The company now expects 18 to 19 million total broadband customers by the end of 2030.

stories.name_fr: Autorisation de retour aux actionnaires pour 2026
stories.story_fr: T-Mobile dispose d’une autorisation de retour aux actionnaires pouvant atteindre 14,6 milliards de dollars pour 2026.
stories.story_en: T-Mobile has an authorization of up to $14.6 billion for stockholder returns in 2026.
stories.citation: highlighted by an up to $14.6 billion authorization for 2026

stories.explanation: Application de relation client, plus de 100 millions d’installations.

stories.story_en: The T-Life app has approximately 24 million monthly active users.
stories.citation: approximately 24 million monthly active users engaging with the app multiple times a month
